issues.title: Growing valid history eventually disables cancellation and close
issues.description: verification_files includes every operation and result forever. Every successful helper response serializes a full path/stamp/SHA row per file. send replaces any encoded response larger than FRAME_LIMIT65536 with infrastructure failure. There is no history bound, paging or bounded summary. client_event requires this job for every non-poll action, including cancel-operation and close-session.
issues.consequence: A sufficiently long otherwise valid completed history necessarily exceeds the response ceiling. From that point cancel/close/reattach/transfer/new admission cannot reach dispatch. A just-admitted pending operation whose publication crosses that size boundary cannot be cancelled through the API: the helper failure occurs before cancel_requested publication and deadline arming. Idle sessions also cannot close normally. This is a deterministic growth boundary, independent of scheduler speed or hostile input.
issues.authority: Preserve seven calls, original operation/history and cancellation invariants while moving full reconciliation off the event loop. Bounded helper transport must not make safety calls unavailable as legal durable history grows.
